scripts.build: npm run build -w @xcavate/shared && npm run build -w @xcavate/server && npm run build -w @xcavate/extension
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p extension --noEmit
scripts.e2e: npm run build -w @xcavate/shared && npm run build -w @xcavate/extension && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
